sources.locator: "War in Darfur", revision 1375318567, § Origins of the conflict

explanation: The English article gives several different explanations for the origins of the conflict that started in 2003 — land disputes between semi-nomadic herders and sedentary farmers, access to water, and the two rebel groups against the Khartoum government — and among them says the Darfur crisis is also related to the First and Second Sudanese civil wars between the Arab-dominated government and the Christian and animist black southerners. The article relates them and does not rank them: this link is one of several the page offers and is written at the strength the page gives it.
